_comment: Shared waveform colors for EVERY display that draws audio — the main Waveform panel and the mixer ENV7 envelope scope. Swap this file (or Resources.Load a different one via WaveformPalette.Load) to retheme both at once. colorMode: 0 solid body, 1 spectral-centroid gradient (warm low -> cool high), 2 band mix (low/mid/high energies).
